verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Windows has an official, documented CLI: PowerShell, documented at learn.microsoft.com/powershell/scripting/overview. That covers the core of the story, but the pack offers only this single probe pointer and no detail on its capabilities. Missing for 10: detail on CLI capabilities or scripting features, AI-native or agent-oriented CLI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
